summary: A native iPhone app in Swift with UIKit screens built in code, a navigation coordinator and tests that run on a simulator.
description: Start a native iPhone app in Swift with UIKit screens laid out in code. A scene delegate loads validated settings and hands navigation to a coordinator; each screen is a view controller rendering a main-actor view model, and the list uses a diffable data source with loading, empty and error states. XcodeGen generates the Xcode project, SwiftLint and swift-format check the code, Swift Testing unit tests hold a line-coverage floor, and XCUITest runs the journeys with accessibility audits on a simulator. The list reads a bundled JSON file, so a real data source, more screens and any backend are yours to add.
seoDescription: A UIKit iPhone app recipe in Swift: Auto Layout in code, coordinator navigation, strict-concurrency MVVM, a diffable list, XcodeGen, Swift Testing, XCUITest.
